task: annotation distribution, same-prediction S1/S2 gradients, saved-checkpoint sensitivity; no training
checkpoint_note: epochN.pt is zero-indexed, i.e. N+1 completed epochs; best is separately historical, not a new primary endpoint

gradient.references: 20 last EMA checkpoints; both supervision references
gradient.target: primary: gradient w.r.t. pre-DFL box logits, not full parameter gradients
gradient.parameter_check: both architectures and S1/S2, seed42, 32 fixed stratified train images, batch2, all trainable parameters
gradient.normalization: same positive assignment, detached target scores, gains and normalization; native S1 and native S2 objectives on same predictions
gradient.limitations: unaugmented endpoint diagnostic, not a replay of SGD or causal proof; per-instance gradient coordinates are disjoint but parameter gradients can cancel

checkpoint_eval.selection: secondary only: choose among 51/101/151/200 by mean A/B VAL AP50:95, earliest tie; never select on test
checkpoint_eval.aggregation: five paired seeds; all fixed checkpoints retained; 95% t intervals descriptive, no new confirmatory p-values

annotation: audit row grain; exact-coordinate comparison, mutually exclusive IoU bins; geometry based on A and repeated with B; no adjudicated truth
